dedupe_keys.name: morichi a dataset to study urban overheating during extreme heat in a hot summer humid continental climate

description: MORICHI: a Dataset to Study Urban Overheating during Extreme Heat in a Hot-Summer Humid Continental Climate is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Miguel Martin et al. This paper describes a firsthand and open dataset comprising weather data collected from four street-level stations and microscale thermal images captured by a single infrared thermal camera during an extreme heat event in late August 2024 in Pittsburgh, United States. Coverage: national (US); published in 2026. Formats: CSV, Image, Python. The data are held in 4TU.ResearchData and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
